# Sirach Chapter 24 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 24 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

*[WISDOM'S SELF-PRAISE — theological climax of Sirach. Wisdom speaks in the divine council, then identifies herself with the Torah of Moses. This chapter stands behind John 1:1-18, Colossians 1:15-20, and Proverbs 8.]*

**24:1** Wisdom will-praise her-own-soul and in-the-midst of-her-people she-will-glory.

**24:2** In-the-assembly of-the-Most-High she-will-open her-mouth, and before his-host she-will-glory:

**24:3** "I came-forth from-the-mouth of-the-Most-High, and like a-mist I-covered the-earth.

**24:4** I-dwelt in-high-places, and my-throne was in a-pillar of-cloud.

**24:5** The-circle of-heaven I-encircled alone, and in-the-depth of-the-abysses I-walked about.

**24:6** In-the-waves of-the-sea and in-all-the-earth, and in-every-people and nation I-held-sway.

**24:7** With all-of-these I-sought rest, and in-whose-inheritance I-would-lodge.

**24:8** Then-the-Creator of-all gave-me-a-command, and he-who-created me rested my-tent, and he-said, 'Let-your-dwelling-place be in Jacob, and in Israel your-inheritance.'

**24:9** Before-the-age, from-the-beginning, he-created me, and unto the-age I-will-not-cease.

**24:10** In-the-holy-tent I-ministered before-him, and thus in Zion I-was-established.

**24:11** In-the-city he-loved likewise he-caused-me-to-rest, and in Jerusalem was my-authority.

**24:12** And I-took-root in-an-honored-people, and in-the-portion of-the-LORD, his-inheritance.

**24:13** Like a-cedar in Lebanon I-was-exalted, and like a-cypress on the-mountains of-Hermon.

**24:14** Like a-palm-tree I-was-exalted in-En-gedi, and like rose-bushes in Jericho; like a-beautiful-olive-tree in-the-plain, and like a-plane-tree I-was-exalted.

**24:15** Like cinnamon and aspalathos of-spices I-gave-fragrance, and like choice-myrrh I-gave-out sweet-aroma; like galbanum and onycha and stacte, and like the-scent of-frankincense in-the-tent.

**24:16** Like a-terebinth I-spread-out my-branches, and my-branches are-branches of-glory and of-grace.

**24:17** Like a-vine I-put-forth shoots of-grace, and my-flowers are-fruit of-glory and of-richness.

**24:19** Come-to-me, you-who-desire me, and be-filled from-my-produce.

**24:20** For my-remembrance is-sweeter than honey, and my-inheritance than the-honeycomb.

**24:21** Those-who-eat me will-hunger still, and those-who-drink me will-thirst still.

**24:22** Whoever-obeys me will-not-be-put-to-shame, and those-who-work with-me will-not-sin."

**24:23** All these-things are the-book of-the-covenant of-the-Most-High God, the-law which Moses commanded us as an-inheritance for-the-assemblies of Jacob.

**24:24** [He-fills-with-wisdom like the-Pishon, and like the-Tigris in-the-days of-the-new-fruits.]

**24:25** He-fills-with-understanding like the-Euphrates, and like the-Jordan in-the-days of-harvest.

**24:26** He-makes-instruction shine-forth like light, like the-Gehon in-the-days of-the-vintage.

**24:27** The-first-one has-not-finished knowing her, and likewise the-last-one has-not-traced-out her-ways.

**24:28** For from-the-sea her-thought is-filled, and her-counsel from-the-great-deep.

**24:29** I myself, like a-canal-ditch from a-river, and like a-water-channel I-went-out into a-garden.

**24:30** I-said, "I-will-water my-garden and I-will-water-abundantly my-garden-bed"; and behold, my-canal became a-river, and my-river became a-sea.

**24:31** Again I-will-make-instruction-shine like the-morning-light, and I-will-cause-it-to-gleam afar.

**24:32** Again I-will-pour-out teaching like prophecy, and I-will-leave-it for-the-generations-of-the-age.

**24:33** See that I-have-not-labored for-myself-alone, but for-all-those-who-seek her.

**24:34** [See that I-have-not-labored for-myself-alone, but for all-those-who-seek her.]
